Comment: The content pipeline's steps (Epic 146, Specs/ADR_Content_Pipeline.md). Each step's Script runs in the editor (run_in_editor.py) and owns its Outputs; its Inputs are the files it reads. Library counts as a source of every step. Paths are relative to the repo root; a directory stands for every file in it.

Steps.Description: The default level, /Game/Maps/GameMap: lit, with the match as its game mode. The field builds itself at runtime from data.

The field's look (lane V2): the CC0 turf textures and the day and night skies imported from RawAssets/field, the MPC_Field collection, and the world-aligned turf (M_Turf, M_TurfLite) and painted-grass (M_FieldPaint) materials that APSFieldSurface and the stadium lighting name in Data/field_markings.json and Data/stadium_lighting.json.
